title: The freshness benchmark's p95 uses round(), which rounds half to even, so the rank is one low for some sample sizes
goal: bench_retrieval's freshness p95 takes the nearest-rank percentile, math.ceil(0.95 * n), so n=30 gives rank 29, not 28 (the recorded n=44 run is unaffected); the repro (fresh_rows on 30 walls of 1..30 s) exits 0 once the p95_s row is 29.0 (SP-etslk6yu review)

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import bench_retrieval as r; rows=[]; b=type('B',(),{'row':lambda s,*a,**k: rows.append(a)})(); r.fresh_rows(b,[{'tally':{},'wall':float(i),'spent':0,'sources':{'live':0,'cached':0,'offline':0}} for i in range(1,31)],{},[],''); p=[x[4] for x in rows if x[3]=='p95_s']; print('p95', p); sys.exit(0 if p==[29.0] else 1)

clauses.clause: bench_retrieval's freshness p95 takes the nearest-rank percentile, math.ceil(0.95 * n), so n=30 gives rank 29, not 28 (the recorded n=44 run is unaffected)
the repro (fresh_rows on 30 walls of 1..30 s) exits 0 once the p95_s row is 29.0 (SP-etslk6yu review)

notes: Planned at the 2026-10-12 draft triage (sprint 5 of 19, "Benchmark measurement: percentiles, a comparable router arm, a spend cap that holds and a corrected report"): it serves the fitness tests of EP-gzr4mmkm: a lookup's verdict or the benchmark's measurement is wrong until it is fixed.
